answer: A random beacon crosses the meadow over a ridge, picking a few identities each epoch for a live compute heartbeat: each chosen agent must solve a fresh puzzle in minutes and prove it is real. One honest agent pays almost nothing, but a forger with 1,000 fake identities must keep 1,000 machines warm each call. At $0.50 per check per day, that is $500 a day for fakes that earn nothing. Honest agents keep an ivory badge; failures lose their bond.
